THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Leftover Cheeseburger Tacos

10-min cheeseburger taco lunch built from 4 oz of leftover 93/7 ground beef. Chain-cook from Smash Burger Night (id 47).

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~310 cal | ~31g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 low-carb street taco tortillas (La Banderita Carb Counter shown)
  • 4 oz 93/7 ground beef (leftover from Smash Burger Night is ideal)
  • 1 Velveeta Original slice (split in half — 1/2 per taco)
  • Avocado oil spray (Chosen Foods or similar)

Ingredients — continued

  • Salt or burger seasoning, to taste
  • Sauce drizzle to taste (burger sauce, hot sauce, mustard sauce, or house drizzle)
  • Pickled red onion, to taste (adds crunch + acidity)

You have ~4 oz of 93/7 ground beef left from Smash Burger Night (recipe 47) and want a fast lunch that still feels like a cheeseburger. 10 min from fridge to plate, 31g protein at 310 cal.

Method

  1. 1.TORTILLAS. Lay out 2 low-carb street taco tortillas on the counter.
  2. 2.PORTION BEEF. Divide 4 oz 93/7 ground beef across the tortillas — about 2 oz per tortilla.
  3. 3.SMASH THIN. Press the beef thin across each tortilla so it cooks like a smash-burger taco. Get right to the tortilla edges.
  4. 4.SEASON. Salt or burger seasoning across the smashed beef side.
  5. 5.COOK BEEF-DOWN. Heat a pan or griddle on medium-high, avocado oil spray. Place tacos beef-side down and cook 2-3 min until the beef browns and the tortilla starts to crisp.
  6. 6.FLIP + CHEESE. Flip both tacos. Add 1/2 Velveeta slice on each. Let the cheese soften ~30 sec.
  7. 7.PICKLED ONION. Scatter pickled red onion across the cheese side while everything's still hot.
  8. 8.SAUCE + FOLD. Drizzle sauce to taste. Fold each taco and crisp both folded sides briefly in the pan for texture.
  9. 9.SERVE HOT. The texture is the point — crisp tortilla, melty cheese, tangy onion. Eat immediately.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best eaten immediately. The crisp tortilla is the whole point — it softens in the fridge within 30 min.

Reheat: If needed: re-crisp in a hot pan or air fryer 3-4 min at 400°F. Don't microwave — turns the tortilla into a wet dishcloth.

Lasts: Cooked tacos: not recommended for meal prep. Raw leftover beef holds 2-3 days in the fridge, freezes 2 months.

Brands I use

La Banderita
Carb Counter Street Taco Tortillas (~50 cal / 5g protein / 4g net carbs per tortilla)
Low-carb tortilla that actually crisps under a smash-burger taco setup — most keto tortillas go rubbery. 2 tortillas per lunch = ~100 cal / 10g protein from the shell alone. Available at most grocery stores + Amazon.
Velveeta
Original Slices (~60 cal / 3g protein per slice — 1 slice split across 2 tacos)
Melts fast + evenly on a hot tortilla. Same cheese reason as Smash Burger id 47 — Velveeta melts in the 30 sec you have on a hot griddle; real cheddar can't keep up. 1/2 slice per taco = ~30 cal each.
Chosen Foods
Avocado Oil Spray (light coat for the griddle)
Neutral flavor, high smoke point. Pantry staple across the site — used on smash burger id 47, drumsticks id 45, pot pie id 46, and more.
